message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts. The facts: illegal profit by introducing others to virtually issue VAT special invoices for a company, causing tax loss. Also found forged invoices (machine printed and ordinary). So crimes: 虚开增值税专用发票 (fictitious VAT special invoices) used to evade tax, also 伪造发票 (forgery of invoices). In Chinese criminal law, there is crime of "虚开增值税专用发票罪" and also "伪造、变造国家机关公文、证件、印章罪"? But forging invoices is covered under "伪造、变造发票罪"? Actually Chinese law: "伪造、变造国家机关公文、证件、印章罪" includes forging tax invoices? There is also "伪造、变造发票罪" under "伪造、变造国家机关公文、证件、印章罪". In examples earlier, they labeled "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" for selling forged marriage certificate. For forged invoices, they used "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章"? Not exactly. In earlier examples, they had "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票". For forging invoices, they didn't have example. But likely the charge is "伪造、变造发票" maybe "伪造、变造国家机关公文、证件、印章". However the invoice is a tax document issued by tax authority, considered a state document. So forging them is "伪造、变造国家机关公文、证件、印章罪". But the main crime is "虚开增值税专用发票罪". Also maybe "非法经营罪"? No.

Thus answer: [罪名]虚开增值税专用发票;伪造、变造国家机关公文、证件、印章<eoa>
